name: plat
description: Chipset checks at the ports: 8254 PIT channel 2 (access modes, modes 0/2/3, BCD, read-back), MC146818 RTC/CMOS (format, tick, rate vs PIT, periodic flag, alarm, RAM), 8259 PICs (IMR, IRR with interrupts off, ELCR) and 8237 DMA (address/count/page registers, software-requested verify transfer).
